programs.description: Kion, Simba's son, becomes the leader of the Lion Guard, striving to protect the wildlife from dangerous powers and attempts to maintain peace.
Mickey, Minnie, Pluto, Goofy, Daisy, Donald and many other clubhouse friends go on educational adventures and impart important lessons in a fun way.
During the day, Amaya, Connor and Greg lead totally normal lives, but they transform into superheroes during the night and use their powers to fight villains and solve mysteries.
